prompt: The young nurse stands on the spot with the clipboard pressed to her chest, facing the same way at the same size in frame, the camera nearly still. She draws a small breath, fingers tightening on the clipboard edge, and keeps her eyes on the people just beside the camera. She says: One ward. Six months. If readmissions don't fall by a tenth, you stop paying me. Her voice is slightly nervous at the start but she steadies, giving a small firm nod on the last words and holding her gaze. The staircase and brick wall behind her stay steady. Sound: her young female voice, earnest and clear, over the quiet room tone of a big brick loft.
